comments.value: Fuck that, I'm tired of unity version updates.

We could have SDK update easily through Unity Package Manager in Unity2019.4!
Also, we could create editor extensions easily through UIElements in Unity2019!

@{5c021357a58d0a7e70c3e515|full_name}: Any version of Unity will not be supported forever.
The remaining support duration of Unity 2018 is less than one year.
Why is this abandoned ? If you are awaiting Unity 2020.3 LTS, I think it is not a bad idea.But remember,we could not stay Unity 2018 forever.Its end of life is approaching!
please this will make map creation so much better
@{5d986706e7587b5af3d2265f|full_name}: still sucks having to update everything and its a real pain in the ass

You guys do know it takes a while to change over to the new versions. To get to 2018 from 2017 it took 6months of waiting and probably more during the update just to make sure everything was supported correctly.

Yes please.
The current version of Unity is truly awful to work in. Missing Shader Nodes, and Superior Lighting Pipelines. Ideally a even newer version of Unity would be nice- but whatever has the new bells & whistles, while being stable should be a high priority.

@{5fb04a412b39d15e32b2cd23|full_name}: Shader Graph is only supported in Scriptable Render Pipeline.
And switching render pipeline makes all existing shaders unusable.
So it will not work on VRChat even if its Unity version is updated to latest.
